photos.description: Sturgeon Falls offer half a dozen outstanding surfing waves. Some of the waves are breaking waves, others are more holes, and one is a ledge causing a hole. This is a safe place to play. Since there are several waves to surf on you can choose the stickyness you desire. There is a good eddy to rest in that sets you up to catch the wave. On river right there is a smaller but sticky hole.
photos.caption: Big Mouth Sturgeon Falls
photos.subject: Clay Stejskal
photos.author: Clay Stejskal
